messages:
alex.delgado: Quick hit — noticing a Helm templating quirk: if `values.extraEnv` is set to `null` in our app chart, the rendered manifest ends up with an `env:` block containing a stray `null` entry which breaks k8s. anyone run into this?
leila.ram: yup saw that before. Usually comes from piping `toYaml` over a nil value. can you paste the snippet you have?
alex.delgado: here —
```
{{- if .Values.extraEnv }}
env:
{{ toYaml .Values.extraEnv | indent 8 }}
{{- end }}
```
alex.delgado: values.yaml has `extraEnv: null` in one of our overlays (we rely on omission to mean none)
samir.patel: when `extraEnv` is null, `toYaml` prints `null` which still ends up under `env:`. `if .Values.extraEnv` evaluates true for things that aren't strictly false? tricky.
leila.ram: Helm/Go template `if` treats empty maps, zero values, and nil as false iirc, but if overlay system writes the key as `null` explicitly, it might be parsed as interface{} with nil vs typed nil? messy. easiest: defensive guard with `and` + `not` + `eq` check.
emma.tan: simplest fix: check for the literal null case before render. e.g.:
```
{{- $env := .Values.extraEnv }}
{{- if and $env (ne $env nil) }}
env:
{{ toYaml $env | indent 8 }}
{{- end }}
```
emma.tan: or coerce in values: default to `[]` in chart `values.yaml` so overlays merging keeps it a list.
alex.delgado: nice, thanks. i tried `if .Values.extraEnv` originally and still saw the `null`. will try the `$env` guard.
samir.patel: alternatively, use `kindIs` helper in _helpers.tpl to detect map/list: `{{- if kindIs "slice" $env }}` then render. avoids the `null` case.
leila.ram: ^^ good call. helper example: `{{- define "isList" }}{{- eq (kindOf .) "slice" }}{{- end }}` and then `{{- if (include "isList" $env) }}`
alex.delgado: quick question — we also have `envFrom` blocks that are optional. similar issue when `envFrom: null` shows `envFrom: null`. should treat the same way?
emma.tan: yup. treat all optional lists/maps the same. standardize on: chart `values.yaml` sets default to `[]` or `{}`, and templates use a small helper `renderIfPresent` to keep templates compact.
leila.ram: i'll add a tiny helper to repo: `renderIfPresent` that checks `ne . nil` and `kindOf` before using `toYaml`. then we can replace few spots across charts.
alex.delgado: awesome — can you paste the helper when you push? i'll test in my overlay.
deploy-bot: new commit pushed to branch `alex/helm-null-guard` (build 483) :white_check_mark:
samir.patel: thanks, trying locally now, will ping if it still reproduces. :thumbsup:
alex.delgado: closing loop — helper fix worked for me, no more `null` in manifests. i'll send a small PR to change the other templates to use it.
leila.ram: thanks for flagging, good find — added to eng-platform backlog for chart hygiene. :sparkles:
